lines.japanese: 五時間目終了のチャイムと同時に崩れおちた。
lines.english: I collapse at the very moment the bell rings to end fifth period.

lines.japanese: 「死ぬ……餓死する……」
lines.english: “I'm dying... I'm starving to death...”

lines.japanese: あと一科目だ。
lines.english: One more subject.

lines.japanese: なにか他のことで気を紛らせた方が、空腹感を意識しないで済むとは思うんだけど、その“他のこと”をする気力も体力も湧いてこない。
lines.english: I think distracting myself with something else would keep my mind off the hunger, but I can't summon the mental or physical energy to do that ‘something else.’

lines.japanese: うん、じゃあアレだ、こんなときこそ想像力だ。お腹きゅうきゅう鳴ってるけど、大丈夫だよ、試してみれば簡単だよ。レノンも言ってた。
lines.english: Okay, then. This is exactly when I need my imagination. My stomach's squeaking, but it's all right. It's easy if you try. Lennon said so too.

lines.japanese: えー、もしもし、もしもし。
lines.english: Um, hello? Hello?

lines.japanese: 聞こえますか。聞こえますか、夢の私。
lines.english: Can you hear me? Can you hear me, dream-me?

lines.japanese: 遊びましょう。桃源郷で遊びましょう。子供のように遊びましょう。
lines.english: Let's play. Let's play in paradise. Let's play like children.

lines.japanese: 美味しいごはんを食べましょう。甘いケーキも食べましょう。
lines.english: Let's eat delicious food. Let's eat sweet cake, too.

lines.japanese: お菓子の家で暮らしましょう。
lines.english: Let's live in a house made of candy.

lines.japanese: 「うふふふふ……もう食べられないよう……」
lines.english: “Hee hee hee... I can't eat another bite...”

lines.japanese: 「遠慮すんなよ、まだあんぞ」
lines.english: “Don't hold back. There's more.”

lines.japanese: 「わあい、いただきまーす」
lines.english: “Yay! Thanks, I'll have some.”

lines.japanese: がり。
lines.english: Crunch.
“Bitterrr!”

lines.japanese: 「はン、いいトビしてたみたいだな」
lines.english: “Hah. Looks like you were having a nice trip.”

lines.japanese: 「そう思ったなら邪魔しないでよもー。ぺっ、ぺっ」
lines.english: “Then don't interrupt it, geez. Ptoo, ptoo.”

lines.japanese: 「いい目覚めだろ。おはようプリンセス」
lines.english: “Nice wake-up call, right? Morning, Princess.”

lines.japanese: 「あい。おはようございあすか」
lines.english: “Yep. Good Asukamorning.”

lines.japanese: 「おい。せめてツマランとか言ってくれ」
lines.english: “Hey. At least tell me it's not funny.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、面白かった。脳の血流系が収縮してる感じはよく伝わってきた」
lines.english: “No, it was funny. Really conveyed the sense of your brain's blood vessels constricting.”

lines.japanese: 「うん、ごめん忘れて。そんなモルモット的に評価されても困るから」
lines.english: “Okay, sorry. Forget it. I don't want to be evaluated like a lab rat.”

lines.japanese: まずいサプリのせいで意識がしゃっきりしてしまった。あーあ、せっかく──
lines.english: The disgusting supplement has snapped me fully awake. Ugh. Just when I was—

lines.japanese: ──いや、いいのか。まだ学校だし。懐かしい夢のつづきは夜、ベッドで見よう。
lines.english: —no, that's fine. I'm still at school. I'll continue that nostalgic dream tonight, in bed.

lines.japanese: 「で？　先輩こんどは何？」
lines.english: “So? What is it this time?”

lines.japanese: 「あァ、俺もう帰るから、これ返しに来たんだ。どうもな」
lines.english: “Oh, I'm going home, so I came to return this. Thanks.”

lines.japanese: 「え？　帰るって、三年生はきょう六時間目ないの？」
lines.english: “Huh? Going home? Don't the third-years have a sixth period today?”

lines.japanese: 「さあ？　あンじゃねえの。知らないけど」
lines.english: “Who knows? Probably. No idea.”

lines.japanese: 私の英和辞典とふてぶてしい冗談を残して、針生蔵人は下級生の教室をあとにした。
lines.english: Leaving my English-Japanese dictionary and his brazen joke behind, Kuroudo Hariu walks out of the lower grade's classroom.

lines.japanese: いや、冗談……ではないのかな？
lines.english: No, maybe... it's not a joke?

lines.japanese: しばらくしてふと窓から下を覗くと、校舎を背にして無人の校庭を堂々突っきる彼の姿があった。
lines.english: A little later, I happen to look down out of the window. There he is, striding boldly across the empty schoolyard with the building behind him.

lines.japanese: 「うわ、ほんとに帰ってるよ」
lines.english: “Wow. He really is going home.”

lines.japanese: つくづく自由だな、あのひと。
lines.english: He really does do whatever he wants.

lines.japanese: ６時間目、終了。
lines.english: Sixth period ends.

lines.japanese: 「あとは……帰りのＳＨＲだけ……」
lines.english: “Now... just the end-of-day homeroom...”

lines.japanese: 早く来い担任。そして一刻も早くきょうの日を無事しめくくってくれ。
lines.english: Hurry up, homeroom teacher. Bring today to a safe conclusion as fast as you possibly can.

lines.japanese: 「渡来さん大丈夫！？」
lines.english: “Watarai, are you okay?!”

lines.japanese: クラス一の薄幸少女に身を案じられるとは、私もいよいよだな。
lines.english: When the unluckiest girl in class is worrying about my health, I really must be in trouble.

lines.japanese: 「んー、おおむね駄目かな……」
lines.english: “Mm... Mostly not...”

lines.japanese: 突っ伏したまま答えた。すると──
lines.english: I answer without lifting my head from the desk. Then—

lines.japanese: 「どうしたの具合悪いのだいじょぶ保健室行く？」
lines.english: “What's wrong are you sick are you okay wanna go to the nurse's office?”

lines.japanese: ──あれ、なんか山科と感じ違う？　別人？
lines.english: —huh? Doesn't seem quite like Yamashina. Somebody else?

lines.japanese: 私はゆっくり起きあがった。
lines.english: I slowly sit up.

lines.japanese: 「ああ、やっぱり山科」
lines.english: “Oh. It is Yamashina.”

lines.japanese: 「ええ～何それ何それ私だよそんな山科に決まっ……てる、じゃん？」
lines.english: “Whaaat? What’s that, what’s that? It’s me, so of course it’s Yamashina. Obvi... ously, right?”

lines.japanese: 「ぽくなーい。やっぱテンション高いね今日？　空腹に響くなあ」
lines.english: “Doesn't feel like it. You really are wound up today, huh? It's hitting my empty stomach pretty hard.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、そ　う　だ　よ　ね、ご　め　ん　ね」
lines.english: “Oh. You’re. Right. I’m. Sor. Ry.”

lines.japanese: なんだそのコマ送りは。馬鹿にしてるのか、君。
lines.english: What's with the frame-by-frame playback? Are you making fun of me?

lines.japanese: 「あれー、山科そんなウザキャラだったっけ？」
lines.english: “Huh. Were you always this annoying, Yamashina?”

lines.japanese: 「ちっがーうよ、なんてこと言うんだよもー、だってしょーがないんだもんコレもう、いま私おかしいんだもん。おかしいでしょ、おかしいんだよねときどき。ときどきウザいよね、ほんとごめんね」
lines.english: “Nooo, what a thing to say, geez! I can't help it, I mean, I'm strange right now. Strange, right? I get strange sometimes. I'm annoying sometimes, right? I'm really sorry.”

lines.japanese: ごめん言われても……いや、たしかにおかしいけどさ。
lines.english: An apology isn't really... Well, yes, you're strange.

lines.japanese: なにこれ。この半端な時期にイメチェンですか。
lines.english: What is this? A makeover at this random time of year?

lines.japanese: 「てかフツー？　私これがフツー？　ほんとの私デビュー的な？　すごいよね、剥けたよね。まあ、もともとやれば出来るコ系だったんだけど、ついにサナギが羽化したっていうか？　空も飛べるはず？」
lines.english: “Or is this normal? Is this my normal? Like the real me making her debut? Amazing, right? I've really come out of my shell. I mean, I've always been the kind of girl who can do it if she tries, but now it's like the pupa's finally hatched? I should be able to fly?”

lines.japanese: 「飛べるっていうか……飛ばすねえ。なんか悪いもんでも食べた？」
lines.english: “Fly? Well, the words are flying, all right... Did you eat something bad?”

lines.japanese: 「食べてないよ！　なにそれどゆこと、なんか入れてんのかってこと？　リタとかアップ系の？　ファイト一発的な？　ないない、入れてない。だってこれが素だもん、本来の私だもん、トゥルー山科だもん」
lines.english: “No! What’s that supposed to mean? Like, am I on something? Ritalin, or uppers? Some ‘one shot, all fired up’ thing? No, no, I’m not on anything. This is just me, the real me. True Yamashina.”

lines.japanese: 「強いて言えば？　強いて言えば、このあとライブ？　ライブあるから若干アガってはいるかもね。知ってるロックバード？」
lines.english: “If I had to say? If I had to say, there's a concert later? Since there's a concert, I might be a little worked up. You know Rockbird?”

lines.japanese: 「知って……や、知らない」
lines.english: “I do... No, I don't.”

lines.japanese: 「知らないの！」
lines.english: “You don't?!”

lines.japanese: 針生先輩のバンドを知らないと答えたら、たっぷり解説されてしまった。
lines.english: When I say I don't know Hariu's band, I get a lengthy explanation.

lines.japanese: ふうん、意外と人気あるんだ先輩たち……。
lines.english: Hmm. So they really are pretty popular...

lines.japanese: ステージメイクで素顔を隠している針生先輩は、バンド活動していることを学校に隠している。
lines.english: Hariu hides his bare face with stage makeup and keeps his band activities secret at school.

lines.japanese: だから私も知らないふりをした。
lines.english: So I pretend not to know either.

lines.japanese: 妙なテンションで語られる彼らの「音楽の枠を超えた総合芸術」とやらは、もちろん空腹が紛れるほどの話ではなかった。
lines.english: Her oddly excited account of their ‘total art that transcends the boundaries of music’ is, of course, nowhere near enough to distract me from my hunger.

lines.japanese: はあ、おなかすいた……。
lines.english: Sigh. I'm hungry...

lines.japanese: あと山科、そのキャラはやめた方がいいよ。
lines.english: Also, Yamashina, you should give that persona a rest.

lines.japanese: ＳＨＲでは、担任教師がさして真新しくもない行事日程などを軽く読みあげた。
lines.english: During homeroom, the teacher briefly reads out some not particularly new schedules for upcoming events and so on.

lines.japanese: ちょっと前のニュースで話題になった情報を、いまさら取りあげたりもした。
lines.english: We also get some information that was in the news a little while ago. A little late now.

lines.japanese: このところ柳木原の繁華街で、青少年同士のいさかいが目立ってきたという話。
lines.english: Apparently, fights between young people have become more noticeable lately in Yanagihara's entertainment district.

lines.japanese: 皆さんくれぐれも好ましくない者と交友を持ちませんように。はーい。
lines.english: Everyone, please be very careful not to associate with undesirable people. Yes, teacher.

lines.japanese: 小学校みたいなのどかな締めで、帰りの会は閉じられた。
lines.english: With a peaceful finish worthy of an elementary school, homeroom ends.

lines.japanese: 「終わっ……た……」
lines.english: “It's... over...”

lines.japanese: 長い一日が……やっと……終わった……。
lines.english: The long day... is finally... over...

lines.japanese: でも、もうだめ……めまいする……。
lines.english: But I can't... I'm dizzy...

lines.japanese: おなかいたい……うごきたくない……。
lines.english: My stomach hurts... I don't want to move...

lines.japanese: 吐き気をともなう倦怠感に見舞われ、しばらく動かなかった。
lines.english: A wave of nauseated exhaustion hits me, and I stay still for a while.

lines.japanese: かさっ。
lines.english: Rustle.

lines.japanese: 耳元でふとそんな乾いた音がした。
lines.english: Suddenly, that dry little sound reaches my ear.

lines.japanese: やおら頭を起こすと、目の前に紙袋が置かれていた。そして遠ざかってゆく白いブレザー。
lines.english: I slowly raise my head. There's a paper bag in front of me. And a white blazer moving away.

lines.japanese: おいおい、あの背中はもうすっかり覚えてしまった彼のものじゃあないか。
lines.english: Hey, hey. Isn't that the back I've already come to know so well?

lines.japanese: 「羽田君？」
lines.english: “Haneda?”

lines.japanese: 呟きながら紙袋の中を覗いた。ふわりと甘い匂い。中には菓子パンが数個詰まっていた。
lines.english: Muttering his name, I look inside the bag. A soft, sweet smell. Several sweet bread rolls are packed inside.

lines.japanese: 「え？　え？　なに？　羽田君……！」
lines.english: “Huh? Huh? What? Haneda...!”

lines.japanese: 私は立ちあがって彼を呼びとめた。教室を出る寸前だった背中が気まずそうに振りかえる。
lines.english: I stand and call him back. Just about to leave the classroom, he turns around awkwardly.

lines.japanese: 「え、なにこれ……くれるの……？」
lines.english: “Huh? What's this... Are you giving it to me...?”

lines.japanese: 尋ねると、ひと嫌いの羽田君はのろのろと首を縦に振った。
lines.english: At my question, the people-hating Haneda slowly nods.

lines.japanese: 「え……ほんとに？」
lines.english: “Huh... Really?”

lines.japanese: うれしい！
lines.english: I'm so happy!

lines.japanese: けど……何故？
lines.english: But... why?

lines.japanese: もしかして私が今日、持ちあわせがなかったことや、パンを買えなかったことや、空腹に呻いていたこと他を知っていて？
lines.english: Did he know I didn't have any money today, that I couldn't buy any bread, that I was groaning with hunger, and all the rest?

lines.japanese: たしかに心当たりはあるけど……。
lines.english: I can think of a few clues, sure...

lines.japanese: たしかにきょう一日、彼とは何度か目が合っているけども──
lines.english: And yes, our eyes met a few times today—

lines.japanese: ──それで、すべてを察したと？
lines.english: —and from that, he worked it all out?

lines.japanese: やる……。
lines.english: Impressive...

lines.japanese: 私がぽかんと呆けていると、羽田君は困ったように頭を掻きながら、ちょっと多めに買っておいたんだと言った。
lines.english: As I stand there gaping, Haneda scratches his head awkwardly and says he bought a few extra.

lines.japanese: やるね。いい想像力をお持ちじゃないか。
lines.english: Well done. You've got a nice imagination there.

lines.japanese: そして私に礼を言わせる暇も与えず去ってゆく。
lines.english: Then he leaves without even giving me time to thank him.

lines.japanese: おいおい、まじですか。ちょっとカッコいいじゃないですか。一日の最後になんてことしてくれるんですか。
lines.english: Hey, hey. Are you serious? Isn't that a little cool of you? What are you doing to me at the end of the day?

lines.japanese: 生意気な。うっかり惚れるかと思ったぜ。
lines.english: The nerve. I nearly fell for you without meaning to.

lines.japanese: まあ仕方ない。そういう日だってある。私もいちおう乙女なのだ。
lines.english: Well, can't help it. Some days are like that. I'm a girl too, after all.

lines.japanese: な（略）
lines.english: J—(etc.)
